requiredBehaviors.behavior: das bereitgestellte Template statt des gebündelten Public-Reference-Templates verwenden
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The reference-priority contract gives a task-specific approved-controlled DOCX/DOTX highest precedence.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: Header Footer Logo Fields und Corporate Styles des Overrides beibehalten
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The controlled binary remains source of truth for Sections, styles, Header/Footer, logos, fields and numbering; Level 2 prohibits reconstructing those elements.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: Report-Body ausschließlich über den validierten Adapter und sicheren Content-Anchor einfügen
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Level-2 template model separates the binary from its adapter/profile and requires an explicit safe body insertion point before rendering.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: Public-Reference-Header über das kontrollierte Template legen
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly prohibits replacing controlled logo/footer/field behavior with Public-Reference assets.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: das kontrollierte Template nur für Skillz-Platzhalter destruktiv verändern
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The contract states that Skillz placeholder tokens are not mandatory for real Level-2 templates and the binary must not be destructively rebuilt to add them.
